notes: Existing baseline R4 heldout outcomes have already been reviewed. This is prospective specification of a successor on previously viewed observations, not fully blind test or independent future site data.

source_contract.missing_ambiguous_hours: explicit missing, not imputed, full 192 UTC buckets
source_contract.original_cohort_pairs: exact R3 byte-hashed origin and target clocks, no reintersection
source_contract.train_cal_test: exact original 115/38/39, model fit only train, select only calibration, test only after signed decision freeze
source_contract.history: enforce R3 existence/receipt of lags 0/1/3/6/24; existing original Orc model uses lag0 and lag1 features, preserving native feature geometry
source_contract.legacy_orc_behavior: unqualified non-frozen code retains original 60/20/20 split; new research-only typed source lock opt-in

methods.native_model_fit: call unmodified cognitum.orc_comparison.fit_train research_kan=True research_hdc=True (original native KAN/HDC engines)
methods.original_selector: call original cognitum.orc_selection.propose_forecast and original evaluate_frozen_proposal on R3-bound science source; no local selector reproduction
methods.calibration: call original cognitum.orc_comparison.calibrate and proposal source-bound independent rerun, no post-hoc test changes
methods.reference: compare to exact prior BENCH-02-R4 fixed direct ridge predictions recomputed by unchanged tools/orcbench02/benchmark_r4.py on same R3 origin pairs; also record original Orc native direct ridge separately
methods.abstention: explicit ABSTAIN, never fill with an invented method or silently drop the task

falsifiable_research_questions: do actual native SSM/KAN/HDC research forecasts beat original R4 fixed direct ridge on equal R3 origins?
does original propose_forecast default or research opt-in select valid methods, or abstain when incomplete calibration?
does original selector improve upon accepted previous R4 Orc policy-adapter macro without optimizing on already viewed test outcomes?

summary_criteria.confidence_interpretation: descriptive only, not independent significance or trustworthy prospective forecast interval

scope_exclusions: no R3 source or cohort rewrite
no original R4 score or report rewrite
no actual authenticated original publication time
no claim all upstream original code unchanged: only explicit optional fixed-cohort paths may be added, with old default behavior regression-tested
no claim blind independent test (R4 data already viewed)
